name: STE80 Humanizer
tagline: Rewrites AI-generated text to be clearer and closer to simplified technical English.
description: STE80 Humanizer is an open‑source agent skill that rewrites AI‑written text to make it read like a careful human wrote it. It removes common AI tell phrases and restructures sentences toward the ASD‑STE100 controlled English style, aiming for about 80% of the way to full compliance. The tool is useful for developers, technical writers, and anyone who wants AI output to be more readable without changing its meaning. It works as a skill for Claude and Cursor agents and can be run locally from the GitHub repository.
best_for: adapting prose to simplified technical English
removing AI tell phrases from text
